description: YAML authoring source (Format 14.4): YAML 1.2 core schema, JSON-expressible only; tags, anchors, aliases, merge keys and non-string keys are rejected
bundleYaml:
# A YAML authoring source (19.4)
troupe: "0.11"
kind: bundle
characters:
  - id: mira
    name: Mira
    description: |
      A sarcastic starship engineer.
      Talks to engines more kindly than to people.
    entries:
      - id: ship
        keys: [Kestrel, ship]
        when: own.fuel < 3 && 'yes' != 'no'
        text: The Kestrel is a patched-up freighter.
    variables:
      - id: fuel
        type: int
        initial: 0o5
        description: Fuel cells left. yes and no stay strings.
scenarios:
  - id: kestrel
    openings:
      - id: docked
        content:
          - speaker: mira
            text: "If you're here about the noise, it's supposed to sound like that."
      - id: shore_leave
        title: Shore leave
